values.note: NOVA Parks' Bull Run rate table: peak season (April-October) Sunday-Thursday electric 15/30-amp $39, 30-amp with water $50, 50-amp with water $55, full hookup 30-amp $59, 50-amp $73; Friday, Saturday, holidays and Sundays before a holiday $43 / $55 / $60 / $61 / $75. Non-peak (November-March) $34 / $41 / $51 / $51 / $68 ($67 weekends for 50-amp full hookup). A one-time $8 per reservation for those living outside NOVA Parks' jurisdictions. Late checkout $25. $6.50 ReserveAmerica reservation fee (2026-10-14 read). Promo codes on the park's promotions page (25% off weekday electric-only sites in 2026).

values.note: Reserve online (NOVA Parks' Book Now, ReserveAmerica) or at 866-881-0809; park questions 703-631-0550. 'Minimum stays may vary depending on the time of year but campers may stay at one or both NOVA Parks camping facilities for a maximum of (2) weeks (14 days) in a 45 day period.' Cancelling 13 days or less out costs one night (two on holiday weekends). Two vehicles per site besides the camping unit; up to seven people.

summary: Operator rate table: base $34 (non-peak electric 15/30) to $75 (peak weekend 50-amp full hookup), was $39-75 from June ReserveAmerica quotes; added the $8 per-reservation out-of-jurisdiction charge. Added year-round season (peak/non-peak rates), 50-amp + water + sewer, showers/laundry/camp store/dump, ReserveAmerica booking with 14-days-in-45 max. Cleared the Good Sam-derived military discount (no NOVA Parks page states one). Not stated: site count, max rig length, pull-throughs.
